semantic_actions.action: The scan beam crosses only the visible image.
semantic_actions.visible_result: A result receipt exits the registered output port.
semantic_actions.forbidden_misread: The beam scans a magnifier, machine shell, or background.
semantic_actions.closing_state: The image remains seated in the slot and the result is readable.

semantic_actions.action: The result receipt moves out of the scanner port.
semantic_actions.visible_result: The viewer can trace the result back to the machine.
semantic_actions.forbidden_misread: The receipt appears from an unrelated edge.
semantic_actions.closing_state: The receipt rests beside the scanner.

semantic_actions.spoken_line: The same image opens into three evidence layers.
semantic_actions.action: Three child layers rise from the same image position.
semantic_actions.visible_result: The viewer sees one source become three layers.
semantic_actions.forbidden_misread: Three unrelated icons appear side by side.
semantic_actions.closing_state: All three layers remain visibly connected to the image.
